body.message:
The AED 160 per visit for cleaning includes VAT, yes.

On the dog, pets aren't allowed unless approved in writing first. Let me check if we can make an exception for your 2kg dog and get back to you.

For the longer stay you mentioned, I can lock the current rate of AED 9,300 per month for your first 3 months. Beyond that, rates shift with the season, so we'd confirm pricing with you as we get closer. Does that work as a starting point?
